meta.title: ComptaZen — Accounting operations, automated
meta.description: ComptaZen builds self-hosted automation for invoice processing, reconciliation, collections, and Quebec GST/QST compliance. Calm instead of chaos.

Home.h1: Your books shouldn't need a miracle every month.
Home.sub: ComptaZen builds the automation your accounting team keeps meaning to set up but never has time for — invoice processing, reconciliation, collections, Quebec compliance. Self-hosted. Built once. Running on your terms.
Home.problem: Somewhere in your business right now, someone is manually typing invoice numbers into a spreadsheet. Someone is matching bank transactions by hand at 11pm before month-end close. Someone is chasing a client for a payment that was due three weeks ago.
Home.problemHighlight: None of this is a strategy problem. It's a plumbing problem — and it's fixable.
Home.whyBody: ComptaZen is new. There's no long client roster yet — and we'd rather say that plainly than pad this page with vague claims. What there is: a founder with real, hands-on background in ERP integration, workflow automation, and accounting technology, and a deliberate decision to price the first few engagements below market specifically to prove this out with real results, not promises. If you're one of the first few clients, you're not paying a “we're still figuring this out” tax — you're getting a founder-level focus that gets harder to get once the calendar fills up.
Home.finalCtaSub: 30 minutes. No pitch deck. Just what's eating your time and whether we're a fit.

invoice-ap-automation.name: Invoice & AP Automation
invoice-ap-automation.problem: Someone on your team is manually entering invoice data, chasing approvals over email or Slack, then re-entering the same numbers into your accounting software.
invoice-ap-automation.build: Automated invoice capture and data extraction, an approval routing workflow that matches how your business actually approves spend, and a direct sync into QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho, or whatever you already run.
invoice-ap-automation.outcome: No manual entry. No duplicate payments. An AP process that runs in the background instead of eating an afternoon every week.

bank-reconciliation-automation.name: Bank & Reconciliation Automation
bank-reconciliation-automation.problem: Matching bank and credit card transactions against your books by hand is slow, error-prone, and the main reason month-end close drags on.
bank-reconciliation-automation.build: Automated transaction matching. Only genuine exceptions get flagged for a human — not every line.
bank-reconciliation-automation.outcome: Close goes from days to hours. Books that are actually current, not “current as of two weeks ago.”
bank-reconciliation-automation.note: Also available for accounting and bookkeeping firms managing this across dozens of client files — one automation, scaled across your whole book of business. Firm pricing: $2,000–$4,000 setup + $300–$800/month across your portfolio.

ar-collections-automation.name: AR & Collections Automation
ar-collections-automation.problem: Getting paid on time shouldn't depend on someone remembering to follow up. Manual chasing means inconsistent follow-through and cash sitting in other people's accounts longer than it should.
ar-collections-automation.build: Automated reminder sequences, escalating follow-ups, and a clear dashboard of what's outstanding and for how long.
ar-collections-automation.outcome: Faster collections, less owner time spent chasing invoices, a healthier cash position.

quebec-gst-qst-compliance.name: Quebec GST/QST Compliance Automation
quebec-gst-qst-compliance.problem: Remittance calculations, filing deadlines, and document retention for Revenu Québec's specific rules are a distinct headache from general bookkeeping — and almost nobody builds automation specifically for it.
quebec-gst-qst-compliance.build: Automated GST/QST calculation, filing-deadline reminders, and organized document archiving — built for Quebec's rules specifically, not adapted from a generic template.
quebec-gst-qst-compliance.outcome: Fewer scrambles before filing deadlines, a clean paper trail if Revenu Québec ever asks for one.
quebec-gst-qst-compliance.note: This automates calculation, tracking, and organization — not filing on your behalf, which involves separate authorized-representative rules we verify before offering as a bundled service.

custom-special-projects.name: Custom & Special Projects
custom-special-projects.problem: Your business runs on something that doesn't fit neatly into invoices, reconciliation, or collections — a one-off data migration, a specific internal tool, a process only you understand. Off-the-shelf software doesn't bend to fit it, and hiring a full dev team for one project doesn't make sense either.
custom-special-projects.build: A scoped call first, then whatever the problem actually needs — a custom internal tool, a one-off data migration, an integration between systems that were never meant to talk to each other, or automation built around how your business actually runs.
custom-special-projects.outcome: Whatever was manual, brittle, or held together with spreadsheets gets replaced with something built for your exact situation — not a workaround forced into someone else's template.

data.label: Data
data.text: Your financial data stays on infrastructure you control — never routed through a stack of third-party platforms.

cost.label: Cost
cost.text: No per-workflow SaaS subscriptions stacking up over time. One system, built once, priced once.

fit.label: Fit
fit.text: Built around how your business actually approves spend and closes books — not bent to fit a generic template.

audit.label: Audit
audit.text: One system to audit, not five vendors' worth of integrations, access logs, and data-sharing agreements.

ComptaZen exists because that gap is the same gap, over and over, in almost every small business's back office: real work being done by hand that software should be doing instead.

meta.title: Privacy Policy — ComptaZen
meta.description: How ComptaZen collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: ComptaZen is a Quebec-based accounting automation practice. For any question about this policy or your personal information, contact us at info@comptazen.digital.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Our contact form on comptazen.digital collects: your name, your business name, your email address, and whatever you write in the “what's the most painful process” field. We don't collect anything else through this form, and we don't use tracking cookies or analytics scripts on this site.

sections.title: Why we collect it
sections.body: We use this information for exactly one purpose: to respond to your inquiry and, if you choose to proceed, to schedule and prepare for a discovery call. We do not use it for marketing, we do not sell it, and we do not share it with anyone except the service provider described below, strictly to deliver your message to us.

sections.title: Your consent
sections.body: By checking the box on the contact form before submitting, you consent to us collecting and using your information for the purpose described above. You can withdraw that consent at any time by emailing info@comptazen.digital — we'll stop using your information and delete it, except where we're legally required to keep records.

sections.title: Where your information goes
sections.body: When you submit the form, you're taken to a Google Form to complete your submission, and your information is stored on Google's systems rather than on servers we control. Google acts as a service provider for us in this respect. As with any service provider located outside Quebec, this transfer requires appropriate contractual safeguards to be in place — we're putting those in order as part of setting this up, consistent with Google's own data processing terms for accounts used for business purposes.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep contact form submissions for as long as they're relevant to an active or potential engagement, and delete them once that's no longer the case — in practice, no longer than 24 months after our last contact with you, unless you ask us to delete it sooner or we're required to retain it longer for legal reasons.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, you can ask us, at no cost, to: see what personal information we hold about you; correct it if it's inaccurate or incomplete; or delete it. Email info@comptazen.digital and we'll respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information against loss, unauthorized access, and disclosure. No system is perfectly secure, and we can't guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: If something goes wrong
sections.body: If we become aware of a confidentiality incident involving your personal information that presents a risk of serious injury, we'll notify you and the Commission d'accès à l'information as required by law.

sections.title: Complaints
sections.body: If you're unsatisfied with how we've handled your personal information, you can contact us directly at info@comptazen.digital, or file a complaint with Quebec's Commission d'accès à l'information (cai.gouv.qc.ca).

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We'll update this page if how we handle your information changes, and update the date above.
